title: Eat Shit And Die 166
author: bpatrick
body: I forgot to draw Trent and Dave in their winter coats and then just said “screw it” and made it winter anyway.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text: Oh yeah, this was supposed to be an Onan but they take longer and I wanted to post as soon as I could. But Onan is next.

comments.author: Ben
comments.text: I just spend i don’t know how many hours reading your entire archive, and you are simply brilliant. This and Subnormality and are really starting to change my view on life.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text: @Ben: Thank you! I’m not sure I want that responsibility! I just dump my brain out onto the internet – I’m not claiming it’s safe. Can’t go wrong with Mr. Rowntree though.

comments.author: Standard
comments.text: So read all of your Eat Shit and Die so far and have to say 165 is my favorite. Posting under this comic b/c It has my name in it and we all could be a little meaner.

comments.author: bill
comments.text: i really like your little post-script-like sketches for trent and dave

comments.author: confused
comments.text: very good point made with this comic, but I still hate assholes with a passion.

comments.author: Orrange
comments.text: Just so you know, the dialog from panel 6 will now, retroactively, be my story for why I’ve been a dick my whole life.
